message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo, fought on June 18 1815, resulted in roughly **25 000 casualties** in total – that is, men who were killed, wounded, or taken prisoner/missing.  

| Side | Killed/Wounded | Missing/Prisoners | Total |
|------|----------------|-------------------|-------|
| French | ~12 000 | ~5 000 | ~17 000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch & Prussian coalition | ~10 000 | ~2 000 | ~12 000 |

These figures come from contemporary reports and later military analyses; exact numbers vary slightly among historians, but the consensus places the combined casualties at about 25 000.
